sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Infected Factory is a location in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: The factory's old production halls, untouched by reconstruction, feature narrow passageways, worn-out equipment, and an extensive network of maintenance rooms. The infected, carrying an unknown virus, now roam these halls.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - All doors are unlocked on this location.

sections.heading: Insurance
sections.text: All insured items left in a raid by players will not be returned. Upon death, insurance Traders will send the usual in-game mail about dispatching people to recover the items, but when the insurance timer runs out they will explain that their people don't go to the location, didn't find it or died in the process.
